title: Statistical Software Setup
markdown:
## What this covers

This chapter details the software prerequisites and setup procedures required for running the computational tutorials and Shiny applications used throughout the course. It covers the hardware specifications, a local R and RStudio installation workflow, and an alternative browser-based Docker environment.

## Hardware and System Requirements

To follow the tutorial sessions and execute the scripts locally, students must have a personal laptop meeting the following baseline specifications:

- **Operating System Privileges:** Administrative rights to install binary software and R libraries.
- **Memory (RAM):** More than 4 GB of RAM.
- **Storage:** More than 2 GB of free disk space
